source.question: What was the average sleep duration across the three nights from 2024-02-10 through 2024-02-12?

instruction: Open the longitudinal record dashboard. Filter or locate all sleep records with dates from 2024-02-10 through 2024-02-12. Select these sleep duration entries as evidence. Calculate the average sleep duration from the selected entries. Write a care note in the designated field: 'Average sleep duration from 2024-02-10 to 2024-02-12 was [computed average] hours, based on the selected records.' Do not add any interpretation or advice. Set the workflow priority to High if the average sleep duration is less than 6 hours; otherwise, set it to Routine. Submit the care note and priority.

generation.rationale: This workflow tests the agent's ability to inspect a longitudinal dashboard, select relevant temporal evidence, compute an aggregate, ground a note strictly in selected data, and apply a simple priority rule without introducing clinical judgment.
